classification: single representative instrumentation probe; not a qualification benchmark
purpose: Separate host-side stable-slot work from the existing router_and_graph_wait timer without inserting extra MLX fences.

environment.hardware: MacBook Air Mac14,2, Apple M2, 8 GiB unified memory

command: uv run vference stream-generate artifacts/qwen3.5-35b-a3b-4bit-runtime --prompt 'Explain why exact expert routing must wait for the selected weights.' --raw-prompt --max-tokens 16 --store stable --cache-capacity 320 --cache-policy global --decode-cache-policy layer --demand-workers 8 --prefetch-policy none --nocache

instrumentation.method: perf_counter_ns around existing stage boundaries; no new mx.eval call was added
instrumentation.critical_limit: mx.eval(indices) necessarily settles both exact router IDs and deferred MLX predecessors, so it is not a router-only measurement.

not_separable_without_schedule_perturbat: router softmax and top-8 selection compute
deferred MLX work preceding index materialization
interpretation.not_a_claim: This short, host-state-sensitive probe neither replaces the accepted 8K result nor establishes a kernel speedup.
